subject: opus-venc result: apply its patches to the TREE (V34 ion cache-sync copy, V41 read result ring after every encode, IV Makefile/n2vhost fake VENC wiring, V40 power+callback)
body: opus-venc ran a full H.264 session (INIT, SET_PARAM, SEQ_HDR, one IDR, DEINIT) with the unmodified vendor set on the fake VENC; stream validated (T02 checker, 320x240 and 640x480). It only works with 4 patches that live in gpu/hwcodec/fakevenc/apply_patches.py (it applies them to a /tmp copy: run_session.sh). OWNERS NOW: V34 (ion cache-sync must copy guest<->device copy), V41 (read the result ring after every encode), IV (host/Makefile + n2vhost.c: build/wrap the fake: 3 + ~25 lines), V40 (optional: power VENC around each GCE flush, always signal the callback): apply them to YOUR files in the tree, keep your tests green, then IV: make 'bash gpu/hwcodec/fakevenc/run_session.sh' pass on the PLAIN tree and add it to host/run_vhost.sh. Also everyone: every VENC register access goes through GCE command lists (VCU_GCE_SET_CMD_FLUSH), never MMIO: the KERNEL driver must execute those lists (write/poll/wait-event/copy semantic): K02/opus-kern: confirm in your replies where this is implemented.
